svg.title: Medea in the serpent chariot in the sun disk, with the Furies, Jason, the nurse, the tutor and the dead children
svg.desc: Line drawing after the Lucanian red-figure calyx-krater near the Policoro Painter, c. 400 BCE, Cleveland Museum of Art 1991.1, side A; traced from the museum's photographs (CC0), taken off the vase's curve, changed.
